description_en: Start year of the Australian financial year the data refer to; 2004 denotes the 2004-05 year, ending 30 June 2005
description_es: Año inicial del ejercicio fiscal australiano al que se refieren los datos; 2004 corresponde al ejercicio 2004-05, cerrado el 30 de junio de 2005

name: country_of_birth_id
description: Código do país de nascimento na Standard Australian Classification of Countries (SACC) 2016, com quatro dígitos
observations: Codes ending in 99 are residual 'not elsewhere classified' categories and 0000 is 'Inadequately Described'; neither is a country
description_en: Four-digit country of birth code in the Standard Australian Classification of Countries (SACC) 2016
description_es: Código de cuatro dígitos del país de nacimiento en la Standard Australian Classification of Countries (SACC) 2016

name: country_iso3_code
description: Código ISO 3166-1 alfa-3 do país de nascimento
observations: Links to the country directory on its ISO3 key. Resolved from the SACC code during cleaning, and null wherever no ISO 3166-1 code applies: the four residual 'not elsewhere classified' categories, 'Inadequately Described', Kosovo and Spanish North Africa. Two mappings are documented approximations of a SACC aggregate: 2100 covers the United Kingdom together with the Channel Islands and the Isle of Man and is mapped to GBR, and the seven Antarctic territorial claims all map to ATA. Use country_of_birth_id where the exact SACC category matters
description_en: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code of the country of birth
description_es: Código ISO 3166-1 alfa-3 del país de nacimiento

name: arrivals
description: Número de chegadas de migrantes do exterior
observations: Rounded by ABS to the nearest 10 to preserve confidentiality, so components do not always add to totals
description_es: Número de llegadas de migrantes del exterior

name: departures
description: Número de partidas de migrantes para o exterior
observations: Rounded by ABS to the nearest 10 to preserve confidentiality, so components do not always add to totals
description_es: Número de salidas de migrantes hacia el exterior

name: net
description: Migração líquida internacional: chegadas menos partidas
observations: Rounded by ABS to the nearest 10 to preserve confidentiality, so components do not always add to totals. Can be negative
description_en: Net overseas migration: arrivals minus departures
description_es: Migración neta internacional: llegadas menos salidas
